_guide: // schemaVersion: always 1. It tells the loader which shape to expect; do not change it.
// section: heading text plus on/off switches for search, filters, sorting and detail views.
// REQUIRED per bookmark: id, name, url. Everything else is optional.
// id: unique and stable, prefix bookmark- (bookmark-001).
// url: full https URL, or a path inside this repository starting with ./ .
//      A ./ path must point at a file that exists; scripts/validate-data.mjs checks it.
// description: one sentence on what the page offers.
// categoryId: must match an id in categories[] below.
// faviconUrl / image / screenshot: optional image paths; empty removes the slot.
// tags: short labels shown as badges.
// featured / favorite: booleans used for ordering. Visitor favourites are stored in the browser.
// order: manual position. enabled: false hides the bookmark.
